title: JustFit: 200K-Token LLM Serving on a 24 GiB Laptop with Just-in-Time State Management
abstract: arXiv:2609.17475v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Capable open-weight models make local coding and reasoning attractive, but their context and execution state strain laptop memory. We present JustFit, an MLX-based inference runtime that combines KVExec for compressed KV execution, PhaseSwap for component residency, and StateTrans for state-preserving serving transitions. These mechanisms fuse reconstruction and coordinate just-in-time materialization and release, independently of model-weight quantization. In full-execution capacity tests on a 24 GiB M4 Pro MacBook running Qwen3.8-27B MXFP4, three independent runs complete 196,608 input and 16,384 output tokens, increasing completed single-request context from the mlx-vlm baseline's 30,720 positions to 212,992 (6.93x); a separate two-request run retains 229,376 positions in aggregate. translated_title: JustFit：通过即时状态管理在24 GiB笔记本电脑上实现200K-Token大语言模型服务
translated_abstract: 功能强大的开放权重模型使得本地编码和推理变得极具吸引力，但它们的上下文和执行状态会给笔记本电脑内存带来巨大压力。我们提出了JustFit，一个基于MLX的推理运行时，它结合了三项技术：用于压缩KV执行的KVExec、用于组件驻留的PhaseSwap，以及用于保持状态的服务转换的StateTrans。这些机制融合了重建过程，并协调即时物化与释放，且独立于模型权重量化。在运行Qwen3.8-27B MXFP4的24 GiB M4 Pro MacBook上进行完全执行容量测试中，三次独立运行分别完成了196,608个输入token和16,384个输出token，将单请求可完成的上下文从mlx-vlm基线的30,720个位置提升至212,992个位置（6.93倍）；另一次双请求运行总共保留了229,376个位置。在单独的性能测试中，32K输入、64输出的探测达到19.11 tokens/s的生成速度，而重复的32K+6K工作负载的中位数峰值进程内存占用为
tldr: JustFit通过KVExec、PhaseSwap和StateTrans三项即时状态管理技术，在24 GiB内存的笔记本电脑上将大语言模型服务的单请求上下文容量从30,720提升至212,992个位置（6.93倍），且无需依赖模型权重量化。
en_tdlr: JustFit enables 200K-token LLM serving on a 24 GiB laptop through just-in-time state management combining KVExec, PhaseSwap, and StateTrans, achieving a 6.93x increase in single-request context capacity (30,720 to 212,992 positions) over the baseline without relying on model-weight quantization.
